lessons.trigger_condition: a mutating autonomy cycle can otherwise rely on verified neural/runtime gates without computing the configured 100 preparation perspectives and 25x40 expert review cells for the same decision
lessons.prevention_rule: compute the 100+1000 internal QA matrix before every mutating autonomy cycle; hard safety/state/evidence/provenance blockers cannot be outvoted; keep existing verified-only meta-neural learning and bounded market recovery; self-added runtime functions remain allowlisted declarative capabilities; source-level changes remain non-executable proposals requiring protected PR/CI
validation_required: tablet runtime manifest includes tablet_autonomous_evolution_v378.py and preserves v377/v376
quality policy validates 100 senior preparation perspectives before expert review
quality governor computes exactly 25 expert groups x 40 review lenses = 1000 cells
hard blockers cannot be overridden by review ratios or neural confidence
market freshness stress permits only bounded recovery/observation behavior
existing verified-only meta-neural training and transactional execution remain delegated to v377/v376
runtime self-extension remains allowlisted declarative capability composition only
source feature proposals remain non-executable and require protected PR/CI
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V378 adds an internal quality decision gate only; it does not grant source-code generation, Git writes, verification bypass, trust promotion, price/grade invention, market-direction prediction, or physical-device authority
